data.text:
Now I have a clear picture. Let me build the query to:
1. Join order_items with products on product_id
2. Filter for non-canceled/unavailable orders (using orders table)
3. Join with category_translation to get English category names
4. Group by English category name and calculate average weight

args.purpose: Calculate average weight per product category from sold items (non-canceled/unavailable orders)
args.sql:
SELECT 
    ct.product_category_name_english,
    AVG(p.product_weight_g) as avg_weight_g,
    COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) as order_count
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN category_translation ct ON p.product_category_name = ct.product_category_name
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY ct.product_category_name_english
ORDER BY avg_weight_g DESC
LIMIT 5
